newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Pacific Wire to issue T$3 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Wire to issue T$3 bln bonds.

text.p: Taiwan's Pacific Electric Wire and Cable said on Tuesday it would issue T$1.5 billion in domestic convertible bonds and T$1.5 billion of corporate bonds to raise funds for operations.
"Our board has decided at a meeting to launch the two issues to raise T$3 billion for our routine operations," a company spokesman told Reuters.
The 10-year convertible bonds will bear a rate of between 2.25 and 2.50 percent, with a put option right in the fifth year whose yield to put set at around eight percent, he said.
Conversion price would be 101 percent of the firm's smallest average share price in the past 10 days, 30 days and 60 days before the price-setting date, he said.
"The convertible bond issue will be one with collaterals, a rare case in Taiwan," the spokesman said.
Pacific also plans to issue T$1.5 billion of five-year corporate bonds, with a coupon rate of 6.75 percent, he said.
